title: IIT (ISM) Winter Research Internship Scheme 2026
summary: One-to-two-month winter research internship with IIT (ISM) Dhanbad faculty; separate long-term track for 6–12 months.
eligibility: Category I: BTech students. Category II: MTech, MSc and MBA students (PG students already on a fellowship get no extra stipend). Category III (long-term, 6–12 months, NOC needed) is project- or self-funded.

prize.description: ₹5,000 per month for institute-funded Category I and II interns, for up to two months. Category III has no institute stipend.

notes: ₹500 non-refundable application fee; apply by email as a single PDF per the official notice.
